rigor.rounding: Arb operations and lower()/upper() are outward-rounded

graph.connectivity_argument: Each fiber is a clique. The listed support spanning tree has a nonempty cross block on every tree edge, so clique paths to cross-edge endpoints lift every support path to a graph path.

root.conclusion: G(z)=z-CF(z) maps the rational box strictly into itself and has derivative infinity norm <1e-34 there. Since det(C)!=0, Banach's theorem gives exactly one F-root in the box.

full_six_torque_residual_at_root.reason: The reduced torques tau_0,tau_2,tau_5 vanish. Exact reflection D[R(i),R(j)]=D[i,j] and phi_R(i)=s-phi_i gives tau_R(i)=-tau_i.

quotient_hessian.argument: The grounded principal matrix of Q-(487/10)P is interval-PD. That matrix annihilates r; the grounded-minor lemma makes it PSD with kernel span(r), so Q is >487/10 on r^perp.

transverse_hessian.argument: On each class-zero-sum space a clique contributes n_i I; complete cross adjacencies vanish. Every partial biregular adjacency satisfies ||A_ij||_2<=sqrt(d_ij*d_ji) by the 1/infinity norm inequality. Cauchy-Schwarz therefore bounds H below by the comparison matrix, and interval LDL^T proves C-102000 I positive definite.

theorem.hessian: positive semidefinite with kernel exactly span(1_N)
theorem.potential: strict local minimum modulo global phase rotation
